title: Breakpoints evaporate on every canvas reload or preset switch (disabled blocks survive, breakpoints don't)
existing_state: Breakpoint toggles are stored in Form1's _pendingBreakpoints HashSet keyed by React node id (Form1.cs:182, 6756-6771). Node ids are regenerated as node-{counter} on every TextToGraph import (Services/FlowCanvasBridge.cs:330-331), so any reload — reopening the canvas, switching presets, the run-start re-map — invalidates them. At run start they are filtered against the fresh map fail-quiet (Form1.cs:12344-12356) and the set is cleared in PrepareFlowCanvasExecutionStateForRunStart (Form1.cs:13811-13824). Disabled blocks and expanded state DO persist per-preset via CanvasLayoutData and are re-applied by MergeAuxiliaryLayout (FlowCanvasBridge.cs:5444-5463), but breakpoints have no equivalent: they are absent from ExtractLayout/CanvasLayoutData entirely. The project memory also notes the React-side breakpoints Set isn't cleared across preset switches, so stale red dots can render while C# ignores them. Net effect: a user who sets breakpoints, closes the canvas, reopens it, and runs gets no pause — debugger state that VS Code-class tools always persist.
recommendation: Persist breakpoints the same way disabled blocks already persist: add BreakpointNodeIds (stored as stepPath:blockType tuples like positions, so they survive structural-safe edits) to CanvasLayoutData, capture them in ExtractLayout/ApplyLayoutAutosave, re-key them to the fresh node ids in MergeAuxiliaryLayout during LoadCurrentScriptIntoCanvas, seed _pendingBreakpoints from the merge result, and include them in the load-graph payload so the React store replaces (not unions) its breakpoints Set on load.
user_benefit: Debugging a 30-step provisioning script across sessions stops requiring the user to re-find and re-click every breakpoint each time they reopen the canvas or flip between presets; it also kills the confusing 'red dot shown but never pauses' state.

evidence.note: Fail-quiet filtering at run start; set cleared on every run
MergeAuxiliaryLayout restores disabled/expanded — no breakpoint equivalent
